issues.display_title: Issue #64: [Copilot] Support Change Tour Type Intent Detection and Gating Conditions
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Implement RAG Copilot intent detection and action planning for Change Tour Type commands, enforcing dashboard operational conditions (unarchived, single tour).

Scope & Requirements

  1. Change Tour Type Intent Detection:

    • Detect /change-type command and natural language queries (change tour type, switch tour type, convert tour type).
    • Dispatch open_modal client action targeting change_tour_type with auto_trigger: True.
    • Pass active tour context (tour_id, business_name, tour_type, total_panorama).

  2. Dashboard Gating Conditions:

    • Archive Status Check: Archived tours (archived === True) cannot change tour type; suppress the client action and provide educational answer directing the user to unarchive first.
    • Direct Answer Composer Response: In AnswerComposer.compose, return the denial reason directly without invoking the LLM when an archived tour is targeted.

  3. Context Disambiguation & Clarification:

    • When requested outside an active tour page without mentioning a tour, return needs_context asking:

      "Please specify or mention which tour(s) you would like to change the tour type."

    • When a specific tour is mentioned (@Tour), resolve it as the target tour and validate conditions.

  4. Action Knowledge Base:

    • Add actions/how-to-change-tour-type-in-gothru.md for grounding knowledge retrieval.

Acceptance Criteria

  • /change-type and change tour type queries trigger open_modal for change_tour_type on unarchived tours.
  • Requests to change tour type on archived tours suppress the client action and return direct educational guidance.
  • Requests outside a tour without mention return needs_context clarification.
  • Mentioned tour from outside resolves properly into params.tour_id.
  • All unit tests pass (pytest tests/).

issues.display_title: Issue #65: [Copilot] Modularize CopilotPlanner into patterns, client_actions, and handlers modules
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Decompose app/copilot/planner.py from 1,804 lines into 4 decoupled, single-responsibility modules (patterns.py, client_actions.py, handlers.py, and planner.py) with 100% backward compatibility and zero test regressions.

Architecture & Module Decomposition

  1. app/copilot/patterns.py (~250 lines - Leaf Module):
    • Compiled regex objects (_UPLOAD_PANORAMA_PATTERN, _CHANGE_TOUR_TYPE_PATTERN, _NAV_COMMAND_PATTERN, etc.).
    • Pure syntactic/intent helper predicates (is_delete_tour_intent, is_tour_tool_intent, is_single_tour_intent, is_imperative_client_action).
    • Tokenization helpers (extract_terms, GENERIC_ACTION_TERMS).
  2. app/copilot/client_actions.py (~580 lines):
    • Client action detection engine (detect_client_action).
    • Tour metadata extraction and parameter payload synthesis from active page and @mentioned_tours.
  3. app/copilot/handlers.py (~280 lines):
    • Pre-planning gating and clarification handlers:
      • resolve_slash_navigate_plan
      • handle_unarchive_plan
      • handle_split_plan
      • handle_change_tour_type_plan
  4. app/copilot/planner.py (~550 lines - Core Orchestrator):
    • Clean CopilotPlanner class with plan and aplan orchestration.
    • Dynamic LangChain tool agent invocation and deterministic contract matching.
    • Backward-compatibility re-exports for all legacy pattern constants and helper functions.

Implementation Tasks

  • Create app/copilot/patterns.py and unit tests in tests/copilot/test_patterns.py
  • Create app/copilot/client_actions.py and unit tests in tests/copilot/test_client_actions.py
  • Create app/copilot/handlers.py and unit tests in tests/copilot/test_handlers.py
  • Refactor app/copilot/planner.py to orchestrate new modules and provide backward-compatible re-exports
  • Verify full test suite passes with zero regressions (pytest tests/ - 292 tests)

Acceptance Criteria

  • app/copilot/planner.py reduced from ~1,804 lines to ~550 lines.
  • Zero circular imports across app.copilot modules.
  • Existing imports in tests/copilot/test_planner.py continue to pass without modifications.
  • Complete backend test suite passes: 292 passed, 0 failed.
